notes.title: Farmer's Dynasty 2 – Back to the Field!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778107/6ef32e7f60b58df61eb4f19249100617654d4635.jpg[/img]

It's finally happening!

It's been quiet for a long time. We know that many of you have been eagerly awaiting news – and yes, it has taken quite a while.

So, the most important thing is: now is the moment when we set off together again!

A playtest is scheduled for the near future, and we will of course let you know as soon as we have more details!
Early Access is scheduled to begin in 2026. The new date is intended to allow for comprehensive recognition of feedback from the playtest and ensure that it is taken into account before the start of early access.

[previewyoutube=v-grZlamX98;full][/previewyoutube]

The team is looking forward to continuing their work and even more to having you all back on board. Thank you for sticking with us. Thank you for waiting.

Now it's time to return. Together.

notes.title: Your Path To Valhalla
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33018175/e9c251cd1814aafb9432bc894a37d9543eabf6d7.png[/img]

Sæl, Viking! Sæl, Valkyrie!

Are you ready to brave the storm-tossed and raging seas? Do the gods smile on you? Do you have the courage, strength and wisdom to become a Jarl?

Then board your dragon boat and set out on an epic journey that will take you to the starting point of the raid that the skalds will sing about for hundreds of winters in the longhouses. Become part of Vikings Dynasty!

Here in the far north, life is hard, rough and relentless. Here life means fighting for survival every day! Whether on a boat in the middle of the stormy sea, surrounded by your loyal, battle-hardened warriors and Valkyries, or on barren earth, where Uller and Skadi make life difficult for you and your clan – you must prove that you are a true leader.

[previewyoutube=4rTsbYjX9Fs;full][/previewyoutube]

Discover an open world full of secrets, dangers and breathtaking beauty!

[b]Build your own kingdom. [/b]Use tools and raw materials to build a mighty village and turn it into a fortress of the north.

[b]Conquer the wilderness.[/b] Hunt wild animals, explore unknown islands and face the terrors of nature.

[b]Rule over land and sea. [/b]Build ships, master fishing and guide your tribe through treacherous waters.

But that's just the beginning. Gain followers, forge alliances and lay the foundation for a dynasty that will outlast the legends. Master the art of agriculture, perfect your shipbuilding skills and lead your settlement to prosperity and power. Rise to become the unchallenged Jarl and reach for the stars – who knows, perhaps Valhalla is written in your destiny.

Will you go down in the annals of history, or will you be blown away in the cold winds of the north? The gods are watching. Now is your time!

notes.title: Playtest Announcement – We Need Your Help!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778107/c18f5448d6f6f1e5024fdf1cbc12040320d7a48a.png[/img]

Dear Farmers,

We’re thrilled to see how excited you are to dive deep into rural life with Farmer’s Dynasty 2! Whether it’s tackling the daily farm work, lovingly tending to your homestead, or building social connections in the game, your enthusiasm drives us to create the best possible gaming experience for you.

But just as important as your excitement is our commitment to bringing Farmer’s Dynasty 2 to you in its finest form—packed with fun, a vibrant atmosphere, and attention to detail. To achieve this goal, we need your support and valuable feedback!

We’re excited to announce that a playtest will begin soon, and you can already sign up to take part. A selected group of testers will have the opportunity to try out the current version of the game. Your feedback will be crucial: Is the gameplay as enjoyable as you hoped? Are there features or expectations on your wishlist that we could still add?

Your insights will help us fine-tune the development process and focus our efforts where they’re most needed. Once the playtest is complete, we’ll carefully analyze the results, plan our next steps, and keep you updated on when Farmer’s Dynasty 2 will enter Early Access.

Thank you for your patience, trust, and passion for virtual farming. With your help, we’ll make Farmer’s Dynasty 2 a game we can all enjoy to the fullest!

notes.title: Farmer's Dynasty – Substantial Inventory!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778107/a547e948aad025658ea26f34033c7b8b65adea22.png[/img]

Hello Farmer!

Craftsmen have always had to contend with tough conditions. Day in, day out, they drag tools here and building materials there, which puts an enormous strain on their joints. This time, our protagonist is not entirely spared the pitfalls of the construction business either and has to deal with the harshness of the winter weather.

To give his virtual back a little relief, we have revised the inventory system in Farmer's Dynasty 2. In this version, the inventory is weight-dependent, which means that each object has a specific weight. This ensures a more authentic gaming experience and requires a slightly different approach compared to its predecessor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778107/4af10513d8de4b70eef71cad4d8ce18bfbbc5023.jpg[/img]

There is also a very practical tool belt that can be used to carry all your frequently used tools, so that they are always ready.

Let us know what you think of this new feature here, on Discord or on our social media channels!

We'll see you again very soon here at the farm and forget to put Farmer's Dynasty 2 on your wishlist!

notes.title: Farmer's Dynasty 2 - Call of the Herd!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778107/ce2e7962ac1484eeba7dd6c457fae6de9ac2efdd.png[/img]

Greetings, Farmer!

Raising animals on a farm has been a profound tradition for centuries and expresses a unique connection between humans and nature. Farm animals are not only livestock, but also an essential part of an ecological and sustainable cycle that enriches life in the countryside.

Keeping animals such as cows, ducks or chickens also allows you to produce food in a natural way in Farmer's Dynasty 2.

At the same time, animals ensure the fertility of the soil through their natural life processes and contribute to the circular economy by providing fertiliser, as the pigs will do, and maintaining the land in a genuine way.

In addition to their usefulness, animals create a deep emotional connection with us humans. Animals create life on the farm. Whether it's the chickens filling the yard with their happy clucking in the morning or the cows grazing comfortably in the pastures, animals bring peace and tranquillity that we humans often lack. They remind us to be mindful of the world, to appreciate the simple pleasures of life and to live in harmony with nature.

They teach us patience, responsibility and care and raise our awareness for the well-being of living beings and strengthen our compassion.

What are your favourite animals on a farm? Cows, sheep or chickens? Tell us about them here or on our Discord! Don't forget to add Farmer's Dynasty 2 to your wish list!

notes.title: Winter Glamour in Midsummer
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778107/902ccccc6f6b4345f1c2e36a7ad3fd9746939f7f.png[/img]

Hello farmer!

Four seasons - spring, summer, autumn and winter - are the result of the virtual tilt of the Earth's axis in the game and its orbit around the in-game sun. Each season has its own characteristic features that influence the weather, nature and player life.

While spring is a time of awakening and growth and autumn adds colour to everything, summer is usually hot and dry. This makes you yearn for cooling down.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778107/ef54a0c2a5df1e062302d5975401f3ddb2ac9b0d.png[/img]

Fortunately, this is available in Farmer's Dynasty 2 and today we want to briefly introduce the temperatures close to freezing point. Whilst the plants around the farm are becoming bare, there is plenty to do. First off it is recommended that you stow away your summer attire and grab warming gear and use the power of campfires.

Repairs and construction can still be undertaken, some neighbours may need help shovelling snow and someone has been out on the frozen pond drilling a hole - but why? You'll find out in the not-too-distant future.

Winter in Farmer's Dynasty 2 has its own beauties and delights, from snowy landscapes to cosy snow removal. We hope this has got you chilling in the heat, and we wish you a good time ahead!

Let us know if there's anything you're interested in and drop us a line here, Discord or on our social media channels!

notes.title: Farmer's Dynasty 2 - Turning old into new
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778107/1e8fb43de26ec025aa1d9cff8ef089166950658e.png[/img]

Hello farmer!

Recycling is a big topic, because in a world where resources are limited, it is important to recycle and reuse existing materials. This is particularly important for initial repairs and makeshift solutions. Did you know that bricks from ancient Rome were reused, and some are still in buildings today? Wood can also be reused several times, whether through refurbishment or as a building material for new projects. This not only saves time, space and money, but also reduces the ecological footprint.

We have abstracted this form of recycling a bit and integrated it as a game mechanic in Farmer's Dynasty 2. You can now collect all the rubbish and debris on your farm and use it for the (makeshift) restoration of buildings. This idea is inspired by historical techniques where, for example, entire castles were built with stones from abandoned ruins in the Middle Ages. Of course, new building materials can be bought and used later, but recycling is an important first step!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778107/f391e040d4a4edaa0ffaa1f18bd9579935915421.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778107/a168506c59c981a379b1cb64a7d76d1c73722aec.jpg[/img]

What have you ever reused old building materials for? Have you perhaps built furniture from old pallets or used old bricks for a garden path? Tell us about it here or on our social media channels! We are looking forward to your ideas!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778107/9af777139241441304fa922d455ecb3204e58cde.jpg[/img]
 
With best regards!

UMEO Studio and Toplitz Productions

Don’t forget to put Farmer’s Dynasty 2 on your wishlist!

Hello dear farmers!

Just a bit more than four years ago, Farmer's Dynasty was launched into the world of gaming with the intention of combining several simulation genres and breaking new ground.

These days, [url=https://www.pcgamesn.com/best-farming-games-agricultural-games]PCGamesᴺ[/url] and [url=https://gamerant.com/best-farming-games/]GAMERANT[/url] have voted Farmer's Dynasty into the illustrious and select circle of Farming Games 2024. We would like to thank you, our community, for playing Farmer's Dynasty so enthusiastically and making this honour possible.

The sequel, Farmer's Dynasty 2, is already in the starting blocks with many new features and a new story and will be released later this year.  We hope that you will be just as enthralled by Farmer's Dynasty 2 and believe that we will get a lively response from you.

notes.title: Vernissage: The artwork of Farmer's Dynasty 2!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778107/5410cdceaff182bd9e26f0e824f26ce11f54aae8.png[/img]

Hello dear farmers,

Great news: This year we are pleased to welcome a new Farmer's Dynasty title. Farmer's Dynasty 2!
With many new features and possibilities to organise your everyday life as a farmer. For example, seasons with customised day lengths or a comprehensive story that spans many years.

Your opinion on the upcoming title Farmer's Dynasty 2 is particularly important to us. We would like to hear from you now whether we meet your taste and have put together a short survey for you.

HERE IS THE → [url=https://forms.gle/5N8AMMsSdnoJ9UKJ6] SURVEY [/url] ←

We would be delighted if you would take 2 minutes to let us know what you think and help us actively shape the future of Farmer's Dynasty.

Thank you very much and happy farming 😉

notes.title: Farmer's Dynasty - Ranks and names!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778107/1a95b239a684c67f60aa8fcb4030726b3d451e4a.png[/img]

Hello dear farmers!

Small things create big things and small tools can be used to accomplish big tasks. Nothing could better describe our partner that we have won for Farmer's Dynasty 2. From a small engineering office to a global player for more than 50 years.

We are talking about no other than the equipment manufacturer STIHL Holding AG & Co KG.

It all started with the STIHL Type A tree cutting machine, THE bestseller, which was sold all over the world starting from 1926 and was continuously refined and enhanced over the years that followed. Today, every home that owns a garden is likely to have a STIHL product in their garage or workshop and you will be able to do the same in Farmer's Dynasty 2!

notes.title: Farmers Dynasty 2 wishes you happy holidays
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778107/08d8a5eba1d9e4bd852d5c8d7e54906823112317.jpg[/img]

Season's greetings from the farm!
 
The farm has become cosy, wintry, and snowy. Only the turkey has nothing to squawk about!

On that note, may your festive season be as rich in joy and warmth as our autumn harvest and as peaceful as the gentle mooing of the cows in the morning

Happy holidays and a happy 2024!

notes.title: Farmer's Dynasty 2 - Annual cycle, please!
notes.content:
Seasons come and seasons go! This time they are very present and also have an impact on the game. We won't reveal which ones exactly just yet. But as a small preview we can say: The times of day will now be adapted to the respective season, which means: Long days in summer and short days in winter. Snow included.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778107/814427c19233036b954e5539acde55c6a271ae82.png[/img]

There are a few other new features to be found over the previous title. We'll give you two keywords as a little teaser: clothes and growth! What could it be?

Tell us about your favourite season!

notes.title: One is Followed by Two - Farmer's Dynasty Goes into a New Round
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778107/94cc0dc86ca20b1cae68aa26af72748e4df007bf.png[/img]


Greetings dear farmers!

A dynasty needs a few things to fully develop: Will, motivation, resources and time. In Farmer's Dynasty 2, the time factor is rethought. Experience modern farm life, where you can form the foundation for your ascent. The journey continues into the present day, where you can take up your legacy and take the dynasty to new heights. Help your neighbours and battle the decline of the village!

Unique historic vehicles, which today can only be seen in museums, may be revived. Modern machines and vehicles accompany you day and night, through all seasons, because they are now very present.

But not only timeline and historical agriculture are new in Farmer's Dynasty 2, forestry work is now part of a completely new storyline - told over several decades.

Be ready for a new journey through country life with Farmer's Dynasty 2!
